statement: 95 g of ice at -8 C is dropped into 520 g of water at 32 C in an insulated container. Use c_ice = 2100 J/(kg K), L_fusion = 334 kJ/kg and c_water = 4186 J/(kg K). Find the final equilibrium temperature in degrees Celsius.
notes: All ice melts; Tf = (m_w c_w T_w - m_i c_i |T_i| - m_i L_f) / ((m_w+m_i) c_w). Checks: warm 1596.0 J + melt 31730.0 J < avail 69655.0 J.
